title: Chapter 3: Going Out For Adventure
content:
Chapter 3: Going Out For Adventure

Seeing the dry grass he had just picked up, Wang Shuo came up with a solution.

The length of a rope is about 10 meters. Now he is short of 2 units of dry grass, which means he will have 5 ropes. Considering other situations that may be encountered, it is best to have a 60-meter-long rope.

He did it right away.

He first connected the two ropes into one, put one end on the wooden stick of the shelter, and tied the other end to himself, then randomly chose a direction and began to collect dry grass and other supplies.

The fog in front automatically receded, and the fog behind automatically filled up again.

It seems that the current "field of vision" range is only 10 meters in radius.

[Branches +1, Leaves +1, Dry Grass +1]

[Soil +1]

...

Wang Shuo found that the soil must be loose mud or sand to be put into the backpack, and a large pile of soil must be considered as one unit of soil.

Originally, I wanted to find a loophole and use soil to upgrade the shack, which would be much simpler.

Now it seems that getting one unit of wood and one unit of soil may not be as difficult as imagined.

After walking a few meters, he collected 12 pieces of dry grass, and then made 2 ropes, increasing the length of the ropes on his body to 60 meters.

All preparations are ready, it's time to start a treasure hunt.

The fog above the head seems to be thinner, and the fog seems to be dispersing.

Looking at the time, it's 9:30, and it's almost an hour since I woke up.

Identifying a direction, Wang Shuo took a sophisticated stone axe in his hand and slowly walked away.

At this moment, Wang Shuo was still a little scared. The visibility around was very low. He was afraid that a snake or tiger would suddenly jump out.

Now, he has no chance of defeating a large beast with only the stone axe in his hand.

And according to general game experience, treasure chests are generally not so easy to get, and there may be guardian beasts.

He kept muttering to himself, encouraging himself: "Don't be timid... Just do it... For the treasure chest... Demacia..."

If you don't take risks now, you'll just lie down at night!

He carefully observed the surrounding environment, and at the same time did not forget to collect resources on the ground.

Although the temperature around was not high, his palms were sweating.

[Branch +1]

[Branch +1]

...

Along the way, there were very few trees, all of which were small trees two or three meters high. The system prompted that all you got were sticks, and there were very few weeds on the ground, which looked very desolate.

Continue to walk forward, and walk about 50 meters.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo stepped on empty air, and the whole person slowly sank.

"Not good."

Feeling the softness of the soles of his feet, he lost his mind.

There was obviously mud under his feet, but he didn't notice it just now because it was covered with leaves.

At this time, Wang Shuo was terrified, his soul was running wild, and his mind was blank!

He struggled desperately, but the whole person sank faster.

It was not until he grabbed the rope on his body and tightened it that he barely managed to stabilize the situation.

After taking a breath, he grabbed the rope and moved little by little. It took a lot of effort to climb out of the mud.

He seemed to have exhausted all his strength, lying on the ground, gasping for breath.

At this time, he was still in shock and was terrified.

"Fortunately, I have a rope tied to my body, otherwise I would be dead!" Wang Shuo patted his chest and couldn't help but praise his caution.

After calming down, he carefully observed that there were still fallen leaves on the ground in front of him, but the moisture in the air here was obviously much higher.

He took out a wooden stick and kept poking forward. After testing, with 50 meters as the boundary, the front was full of such muddy land.

It seems that the front is not a mud pit, but a swamp.

Wang Shuo frowned, a bad premonition arose in his heart, sighed, and changed direction again.

After exploring again, the situation was similar to the first time, and there was still a swamp 50 meters away.

His heart sank and his face looked a little ugly.

When he returned to the shack, it was already 11:30.

After exploring for a whole morning, he didn't eat breakfast, and his stomach was growling with hunger. He didn't even drink a sip of water.

Although there were puddles in the swamp, the system prompted that it was not drinkable directly because there were a lot of parasites and bacteria in it.

What's worse is that his pants were wet, and there was no fire now. If he didn't move for a long time, his legs would definitely be frozen.

Wang Shuo felt that he was very miserable, but he didn't know if there were people who were more miserable than him. When people see people who are more miserable than themselves, they will always feel better.

Open [Chat Channel].

Li Xiaomeng: "I'm so hungry that I don't have any strength left. If anyone can give me something to eat, I'll do anything."

Huang Feiguang: "What if there's no lighter?"

Zhao Shanhe: "You can try to make fire by rubbing two sticks together. As long as you're fast, there's nothing you can't make."

Tian Lin: "I've tried it, and I haven't been able to make a fire even with my hand speed after being single for 18 years."

Feng Chao: "Save me, no matter who it is, as long as you save me, I'll give him all my property."

Feng Chao: "My fucking birthplace is a desert! It's a desert! It's a desert! There's nothing but sand."

Li Qiang: "Do you know why you're so unlucky? Look in the mirror more often, and you might find the reason."

Ma Fei: "Help! I just found a wolf. Now I only dare to stay by the fire. I don't think I can defeat it with just the stone ax in my hand. Who can save me?"

…

The entire chat channel has turned into a complaint conference.

All kinds of shows are "miserable".

There is no worst, only worse.

"The difficulty at the beginning of this game is really hellish. It doesn't even give a 'novice gift package'." Wang Shuo couldn't help but complain.

Going out to pick up treasure chests? Doesn't exist.

Water, food and fire, these three materials, Wang Shuo currently has none of them. He has not encountered any big trees with more than 1 wood. He did encounter some fist-sized trees during his exploration, but after cutting them down, , but only got a few sticks.

At this time, Wang Shuo's lips were turned purple from the cold. In order to prevent his legs from freezing, he kept pacing.

There are still two directions. If there is no harvest, you may really have to get a box lunch.

He looked at the "diary" again.

I found that the text above has not changed.

With a heavy heart, he took steps and began to explore again.

Ten minutes later, there was still nothing gained. When he returned to the shack, he was a little angry.

"The collection of supplies as promised went quite smoothly, sorry!"

Thinking of this, Wang Shuo suddenly regained his energy: "The 'diary predicts' that I will successfully collect supplies. It seems that there is not much gain in these three directions. In the last direction, I will definitely return with a full load."

Wang Shuo is like a gambler who loses his money but regains his confidence and sets out again.

After walking less than 20 meters, an animal carcass appeared in front of him.

When I got closer, I saw a rat the size of a football. It was scary, and it also exuded a faint rancid smell.

[If an animal carcass is found, will it decompose?]

The system prompt sounded, and Wang Shuo chose "Yes" without even thinking about it.

[Rat skin +1, carrion +1]

I immediately got 1 unit of rat skin and a piece of carrion in my backpack.

When he took out the rat meat, there was a rancid smell that almost made Wang Shuo spit out his overnight meal.

"You call this food? Even if I starve to death, I, Wang Shuo, will not eat this."

After throwing away the rat meat, he wanted to step on it again, but finally gave up because he was really afraid of getting his shoes dirty. My hands still smelled bad, so I had to go to the edge of the swamp to see if I could find water to wash my hands.

After walking a few steps, he turned back and put the rat meat into his backpack.

"After all, this is the first piece of food I found, so it's still commemorative." He comforted himself.

Continuing forward, with the previous experience in mind, he stopped at 50 meters.

After some searching, I finally found a tree the size of a head not far away. In a tree hole 4 meters above the trunk, a corner of a box leaked out.
